kpis.name: Allowance for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover expected credit losses under the CECL methodology
kpis.description: The allowance for credit losses combines the allowance for loan losses and the reserve for unfunded credit commitments, calculated under the CECL methodology over the remaining contractual life of the assets
kpis.signal: Significant increase in allowance for credit losses reflecting higher loans classified as Special Mention

kpis.name: Net Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Net credit losses after recoveries, reflecting the quality of the loan portfolio
kpis.description: Net credit losses represent net charge-offs (charge-offs less recoveries) and are an indicator of the quality of loans extended by the bank
kpis.signal: Increase in net credit losses in 2025

kpis.name: Allowance for Credit Losses Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of allowance for credit losses to gross loans outstanding
kpis.description: The allowance for credit losses to gross loans ratio is an indicator of the quality of loans extended and the coverage of potential credit risks
kpis.signal: Increase in allowance for credit losses ratio from 0.88% in 2024 to 1.03% in 2025

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.summary: The bank must maintain sufficient liquidity to meet its financial obligations and customer credit needs, as well as to seize investment opportunities.
risks.score_rationale: The bank relies on deposits to fund its operations. As of December 31, 2025, the average monthly liquidity ratio was 14.7%, and the bank has an approved credit line with the FHLB of $8.85 billion. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.summary: The bank is exposed to interest rate risk, which can impact its net interest margin and the value of its securities portfolio.
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates directly affect the bank's profitability and the value of its assets. The economic scenarios used in the ACL calculation include interest rate variations across the three scenarios (baseline, upside, and downside). (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.summary: The bank must actively manage its credit risk to avoid losses from payment defaults, particularly with the increase in loans classified as Special Mention.
risks.score_rationale: The bank is exposed to credit risk due to its lending activities. Net credit losses increased by 20% in 2025 to $37.7 million, and the allowance ratio rose to 1.03%. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.summary: The bank must comply with current regulations, including CECL standards under IFRS 9 and capital requirements from the Federal Reserve.
risks.score_rationale: The bank is subject to federal regulations and the CECL methodology for calculating the allowance for credit losses, which may affect its provisions and profitability. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.summary: The bank must manage its market risk to avoid losses from fluctuations in securities prices and market conditions.
risks.score_rationale: The bank is exposed to market risk due to its investment activities. Its available-for-sale securities portfolio was $1.66 billion as of December 31, 2025. (default score, to be refined)
